name: Detect Magic
classes: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger, Sorcerer, Wizard
summary: Sense magic within 30 ft; see auras with further scrutiny.
description: Feel presence of magic in 30 ft. Action to see faint aura around visible magical objects/creatures and learn school.
notes: Blocked by 1 ft stone, 1 inch metal, etc.
